captured_cases.expected_outcome: The full BTM matrix cannot produce a document while one real reader outcome remains unresolved.
The same full BTM matrix produces the located-defects document after the real owner ruling is recorded.

atomic_step.outcome: Unresolved reader outcomes become immutable owner questions, only offered verdicts can be recorded with the owner's exact words, and a located-defects document exists only after the full matrix and queue are complete.
atomic_step.practical_value: The machinery can finish a real 360-degree critique without silently casting the owner's vote or leaking a partial findings document.
atomic_step.stopping_condition: On the unchanged S12 BTM roadmap, ask-owner exposes an unresolved real cell, document refuses before its ruling, answer-owner preserves the offered choice and verbatim ruling, and document completes only when every matrix cell is judged and the queue is empty; the repository skill projection validates for both clients.

composition.assembly_contract: Use owner-bound unchanged and expose it through the managed dual-client skill.

final_validation.failure_criterion: The queue is bypassed, evidence is replaced, or the installed skill projection fails either client.
final_validation.operator_path: Open S12 BTM, run both blind seats across all 175 cells, ask and answer five owner questions, then request document.
final_validation.success_criterion: Document refuses with the real queue open and completes with all exact rulings retained after the queue empties.

approaches.hypothesis: A deterministic reducer can choose one reader whenever two grounded readers disagree.
approaches.implementation: Select a verdict automatically and allow document assembly immediately.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Fast completion, but the machine silently acquires owner authority and erases uncertainty.

approaches.hypothesis: Stable one-question rulings preserve authority without sacrificing deterministic completion.
approaches.implementation: Derive immutable questions, accept only offered verdicts with exact owner words, and gate the document on an empty queue.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Requires owner attention for genuine disagreements, with all reader and ruling evidence retained.

mini_probes.goal: Keep every unresolved reader outcome with the owner and every incomplete state out of the findings document.
mini_probes.practical_value: The machinery can finish a real 360-degree critique without silently casting the owner's vote or leaking a partial findings document.

proof.failure_criterion: Any disagreement is machine-cast, an unoffered choice lands, owner words change, or a partial document exists.
proof.success_criterion: The real BTM run refuses before five rulings, preserves each exact ruling and both readers, then writes one deterministic document.

winner_output.description: One-question owner queue, append-only exact rulings, complete-matrix gate, and evidence-rich document assembly.

mini_probes.work_type_reason: Blind model readers create real uncertainty; code fixes the queue, offered choices, exact owner record, and document gates.
